main.description: Register an OSS / media / dataset source for GCC royalties. Writes to vertex_contribution_source (off-chain). Safe owner must separately call ContributionRoyaltyRegistry.registerSource() on-chain to activate on-chain earnings; until then credits accumulate in pendingEarned.

canonicalId.description: Stable identifier that becomes keccak256(canonicalId) = sourceHash. E.g. 'github.com/etzhayyim/etzhayyim-apps' or 'ipfs://bafyXXX'.

contributorAddr.description: Ethereum address (0x…) of the contributor's smart-account or EOA.

sourceType.description: One of: oss, model, dataset, media, document.

pendingOnChain.description: Always true — Safe owner must call registerSource() on-chain to activate earnings.
